class.name: SteamAuthResult
class.brief_description: Result of a Steam auth server exchange.
class.description: Returned by [method Steam.authenticate_with_server]. Contains the JWT and user metadata on success, or an error message on failure.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the validated Steam app ID.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the error message when [method is_success] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_http_status
method.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the auth server response.

method.name: get_jwt
method.description: Returns the JWT issued by the auth server.

method.name: get_persona
method.description: Returns the validated Steam persona name.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Returns the validated 64-bit Steam ID as a string.
